A decision-theoretic action with grounding and abstention

Source: R/decision-class.R
decision.Rd

The object returned by decide() and the reference decisions. It records the chosen action, the expected_utility that selected it, the complete candidates ledger (every action with its expected utility and feasibility), and the two provenance fields the Independent Oracle Principle requires: grounding (grounding_grounded() or grounding_unverified()) and the abstention record (abstained, abstain_reason). When a decision abstains the action is the caller's safe_action, not the utility-maximal one.

Usage

decision(
  action = NULL,
  action_label = NA_character_,
  expected_utility = NA_real_,
  candidates = NULL,
  grounding = "ungrounded",
  abstained = FALSE,
  abstain_reason = NA_character_,
  safe_action = NULL,
  method = NA_character_,
  inputs = list(),
  metadata = list()
)

Arguments

action

The chosen action. The safe_action when abstained is TRUE.

action_label

A short human-readable label for the action; suffixed "ungrounded" when the grounding is not grounded.

expected_utility

The expected (mean-over-draws) utility of the chosen action, or NA_real_ when abstained.

candidates

A data.frame with one row per candidate action: action, expected_utility, feasible.

grounding

A canonical grounding token.

abstained

TRUE when the decision declined the utility-maximal action.

abstain_reason

A short reason string, or NA_character_.

safe_action

The fallback action taken on abstention.

method

The decision rule applied (e.g. "expected_profit").

inputs

A named list recording input provenance.

metadata

A named list of free-form metadata.

Value

A decision S7 object.

See also

decide() and the reference decisions that produce this object.

Other decisions: decide(), decide_input_rate(), decide_position_size(), is_grounded()

Examples

d <- decision(action = 120, action_label = "rate=120 kg/ha",
              expected_utility = 1840, grounding = grounding_grounded())
d@action
#> [1] 120
